description: List stored chat conversation sessions with their IDs, last-updated timestamp, turn count, and a preview of the most recent user message. Use this when the user asks to see their past conversations or chat history. Operator only: needs the server operator's key (MCP_API_KEY) on the MCP connection (x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer); any other caller, including the chat agent and the local STDIO server, gets error_code operator_key_required.

limit.description: Maximum number of conversations to return (default: 20, max: 100)

name: list_conversations
